preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases has a length between 1 and 50, inclusive.
Each string s in the test cases consists only of the capital letters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(line in {'YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No'} for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'YES' if (stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('A') == stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('B') and stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('B') == stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('C')) or (stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('A') - stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('B') == 0 and stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('B') - stdin.splitlines()[i+1].count('C') == 0) else stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'NO') for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0])))
postconditions.description: Each output line is 'YES' if the corresponding string can be fully erased by some sequence of turns, otherwise 'NO'.
